//: PIKIS backend API. Attach a Postgres service that ships pgvector and set DATABASE_URL=${{Postgres.DATABASE_URL}}. VERIFY BEFORE FIRST DEPLOY: SELECT * FROM pg_available_extensions WHERE name='vector' -- migration 0001 fails loudly if absent. Deploy in SINGAPORE to match Vercel sin1, or every streamed token makes two trans-Pacific hops. Needs >= 1 GB RAM (torch + e5 + BM25 artifact is ~700MB-1GB RSS); 2 GB recommended. Set JWT_SECRET, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, CORS_ORIGINS (exact Vercel origins).

deploy.//: ALWAYS: this is a server, an exit is a fault. numReplicas 1 -- each replica holds its own in-process BM25 artifact and its own copy of torch; two replicas double memory for throughput this workload does not need.
